whatIsEvidenced: Every line below is read back out of the receipt ledger, the Result produced by scripts/result.py, or the GitHub API. Nothing is asserted from the session. notCovered.GUARDED: not bootstrappable yet. The profile requires a `security-command` verification the caller supplies, and no toolchain ships one that runs at genesis: `npm audit` needs a lockfile (ENOLOCK) and a repository at genesis has none. Issue #42 — secret scanning and CodeQL default setup are free on public repositories and need neither a lockfile nor a dependency graph.
notCovered.go, rust: no local toolchain on the machine this ran from; the stacks are exercised by unit tests, not by a real bootstrap.
